strategies.reason: Approved 13 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-13/etf-rotation-design.md): Faber (2010) relative strength with the Antonacci (2014) absolute filter on the 11 sector funds. Run on a list keeping the top 3 by 12-1 month return; at each month's last close buy a listed fund above its 210-session average, sell a held fund that left the list or fell to or below its average; fills at the next open; 3 slots with same-open swaps and marked-equity sizing (etf-rotation-profile.yaml); 5 bps per side; as-traded bars. Research only.

Approved 18 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-18/regime-gate-and-bollinger-squeeze.md, option A): Bollinger (2001) squeeze. Previous session band width in the lowest 15% of its 60 widths, close above the 10-session high, volume at least 1.5x the 20-session median, close in the top quarter of the range, SPY above its rising 50-day average (higher than 20 sessions earlier), for Nasdaq-listed stocks QQQ under the same rule, and FRED VIXCLS previous-session sizing (full 0.5% risk below 18, half risk 18-22, no new longs above 22). Next-open entry, 1 ATR stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars on a whole-market ADR% >= 2.5 screen. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoint 5): 21-EMA trend pullback (ATR-14 control). Stock above rising 50-day SMA (higher than 20 sessions earlier), strategy-owned 20-session ADR% >= 2.5% and average daily dollar volume >= $20M, 1-5 bar low-volume pullback (RVOL < 0.85) into within 0.5 * ATR(14) of the 21-day EMA while pullback and trigger lows stay at or above the 50-day SMA, trigger bar closes above EMA(21) and prior session high, under the SPY/QQQ rising 50-day SMA and FRED VIXCLS sizing gate. Next-open entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.
